call_participants_active_idx.name: call_participants_active_idx
call_participants_active_idx.where: "call_participants"."joined_at" is not null and "call_participants"."left_at" is null

chat_attachments_type_ck.name: chat_attachments_type_ck
chat_attachments_type_ck.value:
("chat_attachments"."media" = 'image' and "chat_attachments"."content_type" in ('image/webp', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png') and "chat_attachments"."bytes" <= 2097152)
        or ("chat_attachments"."media" = 'voice' and "chat_attachments"."content_type" in ('audio/webm', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/mp4') and "chat_attachments"."bytes" <= 3145728)

chat_attachments_dims_ck.name: chat_attachments_dims_ck
chat_attachments_dims_ck.value: ("chat_attachments"."width" is null or "chat_attachments"."width" between 1 and 1280) and ("chat_attachments"."height" is null or "chat_attachments"."height" between 1 and 1280)

chat_messages_content_ck.name: chat_messages_content_ck
chat_messages_content_ck.value:
("chat_messages"."kind" = 'text' and "chat_messages"."attachment_id" is null and "chat_messages"."system_event" is null)
        or ("chat_messages"."kind" in ('image', 'voice') and "chat_messages"."body" is null and "chat_messages"."system_event" is null and ("chat_messages"."attachment_id" is not null or coalesce("chat_messages"."deleted_kind" = 'account_deleted', false)))
        or ("chat_messages"."kind" = 'system' and "chat_messages"."system_event" is not null and "chat_messages"."body" is null and "chat_messages"."attachment_id" is null)

chat_reports_not_self_ck.name: chat_reports_not_self_ck
chat_reports_not_self_ck.value: "chat_reports"."reporter_id" is null or "chat_reports"."reported_user_id" is null or "chat_reports"."reporter_id" <> "chat_reports"."reported_user_id"

conversations_title_ck.name: conversations_title_ck
conversations_title_ck.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'dm' and "conversations"."title" is null) or ("conversations"."kind" = 'group' and "conversations"."title" is not null and char_length("conversations"."title") between 1 and 60)

feedback_events_message_len_ck.name: feedback_events_message_len_ck
feedback_events_message_len_ck.value: "feedback_events"."message" is null or char_length("feedback_events"."message") between 1 and 1000

feedback_events_nonempty_ck.name: feedback_events_nonempty_ck
feedback_events_nonempty_ck.value: "feedback_events"."status" is not null or "feedback_events"."message" is not null

feedback_files_bytes_ck.name: feedback_files_bytes_ck
feedback_files_bytes_ck.value: "feedback_files"."bytes" > 0 and "feedback_files"."bytes" <= case when "feedback_files"."media" = 'image' then 5242880 else 52428800 end

social_profiles_handle_fmt_ck.name: social_profiles_handle_fmt_ck
social_profiles_handle_fmt_ck.value: "social_profiles"."handle" is null or ("social_profiles"."handle" ~* '^[a-z0-9._]{3,24}$' and "social_profiles"."handle" !~ '^[.]|[.]$' and position('..' in "social_profiles"."handle") = 0)
